# NodeFlow

> NodeFlow is an open-source (MIT) browser workspace for creating and editing diagrams. Source code, a live canvas, and an AI assistant edit the same diagram. Projects are stored in the browser; there is no NodeFlow backend or account.

## Key facts
- 38 source formats (Mermaid and Graphviz render natively; others convert to an editable preview).
- 51 starter templates for UML, architecture, data models, planning, and role-based workflows.
- AI engines: deterministic (offline), local WebGPU model, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible APIs. Cloud engines send the submitted prompt (and the active file when inserting) to the provider you choose; the other engines do not use a cloud service.
- Exports: SVG, PNG, PDF, PPTX, standalone HTML, source files, project backups.
- Themes: Studio Dark, Light, Midnight, Nord, High contrast, or match system.

## Pages
- App: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/
- Studio: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/studio/

## Templates
- [Class Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/class-diagram/): Object-oriented class hierarchies, private/public attributes, methods, inheritance, and composition.
- [Sequence Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/sequence-auth/): Interactive message sequence with parallel activations, alt guards, and cryptographic token verification.
- [State Machine Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/state-diagram/): UML finite state machine with composite states, fork transitions, and error recovery lifecycles.
- [Use Case Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-usecase/): Actors, system boundaries, use case ovals, <<include>> dependencies, and <<extend>> extensions.
- [Activity Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-activity/): Initial node, decision diamonds, parallel fork & join synchronization bars, and activity final states.
- [Component Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-component/): Component stereotypes, provided and required interfaces, ports, and inter-service dependencies.
- [Deployment Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-deployment/): Hardware nodes, execution environments, artifact packages, communication protocols, and cloud topology.
- [Package Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-package/): Namespace decomposition, layer modularization, import dependencies, and domain-driven design bounds.
- [Object Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-object/): Concrete runtime instance specifications, assigned state values, and instance link relationships.
- [Composite Structure Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-composite-structure/): Internal decomposition of complex classifiers, ports, parts, and connector bindings.
- [Timing Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-timing/): Hardware and software state transitions across discrete clock cycles and latency windows.
- [Communication Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-communication/): Collaboration diagram showing numbered inter-object messages and call dependencies.
- [Interaction Overview Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-interaction-overview/): Combines activity control flow with sequence interaction frames and decision guards.
- [Profile Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/uml-profile/): Custom UML profile stereotypes, tagged values, and metaclass extensions for domain modeling.
- [User Journey Map — Product Experience](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/user-journey-onboarding/): Customer experience stages, touchpoints, emotional scores (1-5), and cross-functional team actions.
- [Agile Kanban Board — Sprint Planning](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/kanban-sprint-board/): Agile sprint workflow columns with user story estimation badges and priority tags.
- [Feature Prioritization Matrix](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/prioritization-quadrant/): Eisenhower and product management quadrant chart for strategic feature roadmapping.
- [Gantt Delivery Sequence — Product Roadmap](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/delivery-gantt/): Cross-functional delivery schedule with workstreams, critical paths, and milestone QA gates.
- [Mindmap — Product Strategy & Architecture](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/mindmap-diagram/): Hierarchical brainstorming mindmap of product capabilities, performance pillars, and formats.
- [Conversion Funnel — User Acquisition](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/sankey-funnel/): Sankey flow diagram tracking user acquisition, studio engagement, and export conversions.
- [Ishikawa Root-Cause Diagram](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/ishikawa-root-cause/): Quality engineering root-cause analysis across Method, Machine, Material, and People.
- [Multi-Quarter Product Roadmap — Timeline](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/product-roadmap-timeline/): Quarterly product roadmap with strategic milestones, platform expansions, and release targets.

- [Service Architecture & Dependency Graph](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/service-architecture/): Distributed microservice graph with shared core services, parallel domain pods, and telemetry monitoring.

- [Git Trunk-Based Release & Hotfix Flow](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/git-graph/): Trunk-based source control branching strategy with PR merges, release tags, and hotfixes.

- [Academic Research Thesis & Literature Map](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/academic-research-thesis/): Comprehensive research structure covering theoretical foundations, empirical methodology, qualitative benchmarks, and limitations.
- [Scientific Method & Lab Experiment Protocol](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/scientific-method-lab/): Step-by-step scientific method protocol from observation and hypothesis testing to controlled experiment and peer-reviewed publication.
- [Student Semester Course & Exam Plan](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/student-study-schedule/): Semester timeline outlining foundation lectures, midterm review sessions, advanced topics, final projects, and exam blitz.
- [GIS Vector Tile Pyramid & Spatial Data Pipeline](https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/node-flow/templates/geospatial-vector-tile-pipeline/): End-to-end geospatial processing architecture: raw Shapefile / GeoJSON ingestion, PostGIS indexing, Tippecanoe tiling, and Vector Tile (MVT…

## FAQ
**Is NodeFlow free?** Yes. NodeFlow is open source under the MIT license, with no account, watermark, or paywall. If you connect a third-party AI provider, that provider may charge for its own usage.

**Is my data private?** Projects, parsing, rendering, and exports run in your browser, and drafts are stored in your browser storage. NodeFlow has no backend of its own. If you choose Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible provider, the prompt you submit (and the active file when you insert into it) is sent to that provider. The deterministic, Ollama, and WebGPU engines do not send it to a cloud service.

**Do I need an API key to use AI?** No. The deterministic engine works instantly without a key, the WebGPU engine runs a small model on your device after a one-time download, and Ollama uses a model on your own machine. Gemini and OpenAI-compatible engines need your own key.

**What can I import and export?** Import Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz DOT, Draw.io, D2, SQL, OpenAPI, XMind, Markdown, CSV and many more listed on the Formats page. Export SVG, PNG, PDF, PPTX, standalone HTML, source files, and project backups.

**Can I use it offline?** After the first load, editing, rendering, and exports run client-side. Cloud AI providers and web fonts need a connection.

**How is it different from the Mermaid Live Editor?** NodeFlow adds multi-file projects with version checkpoints, direct canvas editing for flowcharts, converters for dozens of formats, role-based templates, themes, and an AI assistant that shows a reviewable proposal before changing your files.
